title: Impact of Psychology on Life Quality in Chronic and Cancer Pain Patients
brief_summary: This study is to compare the effect of pain management program. We compare life quality, pain scores, sleep, anxiety and depression scores, and self report measures before and after mindfulness based pain management workshops.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pain condition for over six months, with diagnosis by pain physician to be of chronic pain or cancer pain.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients unable to communicate in Mandarin.
